t: What Building Code Crosswalk Database Is All About
title: What Building Code Crosswalk Database Is All About
description: Building codes vary by jurisdiction: IBC (International Building Code) as the US base, with state/city amendments — California's Title 24 energy rules exceed base; Florida's hurricane codes exceed wind minimums. Crosswalks map each requirement (egress width, fire ratings, structural loads) across versions and places, flagging the stricter. The AHJ (authority having jurisdiction) has the final word — verify locally. This database is the complete code crosswalk: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
